response.text: A common platform firm may be exempt from SYSC 6.1.3‑CR(4) and (5) if it can demonstrate that, in view of the nature, scale and complexity of its business and its designated investment business, the requirements under those rules are not proportionate and that its compliance function remains effective. In that case the firm must assess whether the effectiveness of the compliance function is compromised, and that assessment must be reviewed on a regular basis. [6]
